note: Scopes are checked in the order listed. `gated: true` means the scope runs in
`npm run check` and CI and MUST be clean. `gated: false` means it is reported
by `--all` but does not fail the build yet — used while a surface is being
brought up to the rule, so the gate can land before the whole estate is clean.
borderWidthLiterals: the rule's property table covers fills, strokes, padding,
gaps and radii — it does not cover stroke WIDTH. A hairline is a constant, and
the only token for it is `--sa-ref-border-width-sm`, a REF token that product
code is not supposed to consume directly. So `1px solid var(--sa-border-…)` is
accepted: the COLOUR, which is what drifts, is bound. This is a recorded
decision, not an oversight — see docs/guidelines/README.md.
allowedLengths: `0px` is not a value, it is the absence of one.
optical: a sub-token nudge (1-2px) that exists to align a glyph against text.
Snapping it to the spacing scale would MISALIGN it, so it is declared instead.
A scope path that does not exist is a HARD ERROR, not a silent skip. The first
version of this config pointed at packages/design-system/src, which has never
existed, and the checker reported a clean scope because the walk threw and was
swallowed. A gate that cannot fail is worse than no gate.
